Once an order is placed, its shipping method cannot be updated or changed to a faster option.
Only US Domestic Overnight and Next-Day Rush orders placed before 10:30 AM PST (Monday through Friday) are processed the same day for faster delivery. For standard orders, processing typically takes 3 to 5 business days before fulfillment.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
It is not possible to re-route a package to a different address once it has already shipped.
If your package is returned to our warehouse due to an incorrect address, you will have 7 days to request a reshipment (note that reshipment shipping costs are assumed by the customer). Unclaimed orders are automatically refunded after 7 business days.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
